pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: Dark Profound Iron lies buried beneath the earth, untouched by sunlight or moonlight. Over ages, it absorbs dense subterranean energy, developing a heavy, dark metallic structure. Its deposits are concealed deep underground, making excavation both difficult and dangerous.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Found across all Overworld biomes, deep underground between Y −64 and −8.
